en-US.app.title: OpenDirector
en-US.msg.installing_runtime: Installing OpenDirector into {target} (first run, this takes a few minutes)...
en-US.msg.waiting_service: Waiting for the local service on port {port}...
en-US.msg.press_ctrl_c: Press Ctrl+C here, or close the OpenDirector window, to stop.
en-US.msg.stopped: Stopped. Your projects are kept in {data}
en-US.msg.service_lost: The local service stopped unexpectedly; restarting it...
en-US.err.title: OpenDirector cannot start
en-US.err.runtime_missing.title: No Python runtime is available
en-US.err.runtime_missing.body:
OpenDirector needs Python {minimum} or newer, and the OpenDirector package.
Run install.ps1 once, or install Python and then run:
  python opendirector_app.py --install
en-US.err.runtime_version.title: The Python version is too old
en-US.err.runtime_version.body:
OpenDirector needs Python {minimum} or newer; found {found}.
Install a newer Python, then run install.ps1 again.
en-US.err.install_failed.title: Installing OpenDirector failed
en-US.err.install_failed.body:
The local runtime could not be prepared. Check the network connection and any proxy settings, then run install.ps1 again.
If you are on a corporate network, try:
  set OPENDIRECTOR_PIP_INDEX_URL=https://your-mirror/simple
  install.ps1
en-US.err.port_unavailable.title: The local port is already in use
en-US.err.port_unavailable.body: Port {port} is busy. Close the program using it (another OpenDirector?) or start with --port 8001.
en-US.err.service_exited.title: The local service exited immediately
en-US.err.service_exited.body: The service stopped right after starting. Open the log file for the reason; a missing dependency or an unwritable data folder is the usual cause.
en-US.err.service_timeout.title: The local service did not become ready
en-US.err.service_timeout.body: Nothing answered on port {port} within {seconds} seconds. Security software can slow the first start; try again, and check the log file if it repeats.
en-US.err.web_missing.title: The workspace files are missing
en-US.err.web_missing.body:
The service is running but is not serving the interface. Reinstall OpenDirector:
  python opendirector_app.py --install --force
en-US.err.dependency_missing.title: A dependency is missing
en-US.err.dependency_missing.body:
The service needs {detail}
Reinstall the runtime with install.ps1.
en-US.err.browser_missing.title: No supported browser was found
en-US.err.browser_missing.body:
OpenDirector opens in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome. Install one of them, or open this address yourself:
  {url}
en-US.err.unknown.title: OpenDirector cannot start
en-US.err.unknown.body:
An unexpected error occurred. Check the log file, then run:
  python opendirector_app.py --check
en-US.check.title: OpenDirector diagnostics
en-US.install.title: OpenDirector setup
en-US.install.done: Setup complete. Double-click the OpenDirector shortcut on the desktop.
en-US.install.shortcuts: Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts created.
en-US.uninstall.title: OpenDirector uninstall
en-US.uninstall.kept: Your projects and settings were kept in:
en-US.uninstall.done: OpenDirector was removed from this computer.
en-US.update.title: OpenDirector update

zh-CN.app.title: OpenDirector
zh-CN.msg.checking_runtime: 正在检查本地运行环境…
zh-CN.msg.installing_runtime: 正在安装 OpenDirector 到 {target}（首次启动，需要几分钟）…
zh-CN.msg.installing_tools: 正在获取 FFmpeg 与 ffprobe…
zh-CN.msg.waiting_service: 正在等待本地服务在端口 {port} 就绪…
zh-CN.msg.press_ctrl_c: 在此处按 Ctrl+C，或关闭 OpenDirector 窗口即可退出。
zh-CN.msg.service_lost: 本地服务意外停止，正在重新启动…
zh-CN.err.title: OpenDirector 无法启动
zh-CN.err.runtime_missing.title: 没有可用的 Python 运行环境
zh-CN.err.runtime_missing.body:
OpenDirector 需要 Python {minimum} 或更高版本，以及 OpenDirector 安装包。
请先运行一次 install.ps1，或自行安装 Python 后执行：
  python opendirector_app.py --install
zh-CN.err.runtime_version.title: Python 版本过低
zh-CN.err.runtime_version.body:
OpenDirector 需要 Python {minimum} 或更高版本，当前为 {found}。
请安装更高版本的 Python，然后重新运行 install.ps1。
zh-CN.err.install_failed.title: 安装 OpenDirector 失败
zh-CN.err.install_failed.body:
无法准备本地运行环境。请检查网络与代理设置后重新运行 install.ps1。
企业网络下可先设置镜像：
  set OPENDIRECTOR_PIP_INDEX_URL=https://your-mirror/simple
  install.ps1
zh-CN.err.port_unavailable.title: 本地端口被占用
zh-CN.err.port_unavailable.body: 端口 {port} 已被占用。请关闭占用它的程序（另一个 OpenDirector？），或使用 --port 8001 启动。
zh-CN.err.service_exited.title: 本地服务启动后立即退出
zh-CN.err.service_exited.body: 服务刚启动就停止了。请打开日志文件查看原因，常见原因是依赖缺失或数据目录不可写。
zh-CN.err.service_timeout.title: 本地服务迟迟未就绪
zh-CN.err.service_timeout.body: 端口 {port} 在 {seconds} 秒内没有响应。安全软件可能拖慢首次启动，请重试；若反复出现请查看日志。
zh-CN.err.web_missing.title: 缺少界面文件
zh-CN.err.web_missing.body:
服务已运行，但没有提供界面文件。请重新安装 OpenDirector：
  python opendirector_app.py --install --force
zh-CN.err.dependency_missing.title: 缺少依赖
zh-CN.err.dependency_missing.body:
服务需要 {detail}
请运行 install.ps1 重新安装运行环境。
zh-CN.err.browser_missing.title: 没有找到可用的浏览器
zh-CN.err.browser_missing.body:
OpenDirector 会在 Microsoft Edge 或 Google Chrome 中打开。请安装其中之一，或自行打开：
  {url}
zh-CN.err.unknown.title: OpenDirector 无法启动
zh-CN.err.unknown.body:
发生了未预期的错误。请查看日志文件，然后运行：
  python opendirector_app.py --check
zh-CN.check.title: OpenDirector 诊断
zh-CN.install.title: OpenDirector 安装
zh-CN.install.done: 安装完成。双击桌面上的 OpenDirector 快捷方式即可使用。
zh-CN.install.shortcuts: 已创建桌面和开始菜单快捷方式。
zh-CN.uninstall.title: OpenDirector 卸载
zh-CN.update.title: OpenDirector 更新
